title: Define Slack sales-signal notification format (triage fields + copy)
creator: Nikhil Sharma
description:
Context
- We’re shipping v1 of PLG→Sales signals. High-intent signals will optionally post to Slack (#sales and, for expansion candidates, #customer-success).
- The message has to be scannable in-channel, explain “what happened / why it matters / what to do next”, and link cleanly to HubSpot.
- Constraints: no user-level PII; keep noise low; include dedupe/cool-down context so reps trust the alerts.

Goals
1) Define a single Slack message template (Block Kit) that is consistent across signal types.
2) Specify the minimum required fields so Eng can implement and Sales can triage quickly.
3) Provide copy conventions (naming, tone, abbreviations) for reliability.

Non-goals
- Not designing the scoring model or thresholds (see PRD/design spec).
- Not deciding which channels get which signals (that’s routing config); we only define the format and optional channel-specific variant.

Primary users
- SDRs/AEs monitoring #sales for new outreach-worthy accounts.
- CSMs monitoring #customer-success for expansions / governance concerns.

Message requirements (v1)
- Should fit in a single Slack message without scrolling on desktop (target: ~8–12 lines of readable text + links).
- Must have a clear “Next best action” with owner suggestion (AE/SDR vs CSM) and a playbook link.
- Must include signal freshness (“window” + timestamp) and cool-down/dedupe context.
- Must be safe to share in Slack: no email addresses, no individual user identifiers, no raw prompt data.

Template structure (Block Kit)
A) Header
- Title: “PLG Signal: {Signal Name}”
- Severity indicator: {High Intent | Medium Intent} (avoid “HOT LEAD” phrasing)

B) Summary line (one-liner)
- “{Company Name} ({domain}) crossed {trigger} in the last {window}.”

C) What happened (facts)
Include these fields (required):
- Company: {company_name}
- Domain: {company_domain}
- Segment/Geo: {NA | EMEA | APAC} + {self-serve tier if available}
- Signal: {signal_type}
- Window: {7d | 14d | 30d}
- Score: {0–100} and/or {Band: High/Med} (final label TBD by Eng; message should support either)
- Key metrics: 1–3 metrics max, chosen per signal type (e.g., “Spend 30d: $X (+Y% WoW)”; “429 rate limits: N/day”; “Concurrency p95: N”; “Pricing page views: N in 7d”)
- Freshness: “Detected: {timestamp}”

D) Why it matters (interpretation)
- One short sentence mapped from signal_type, e.g.:
  - Sustained spend growth: “Likely scaling usage; Dedicated may reduce unit cost and improve predictability.”
  - Repeated 429s/rate limit: “They’re being throttled; capacity/quotas or Dedicated can unblock.”
  - Security intent: “Procurement/security motion may be starting; offer security packet + roadmap.”
  - Region/residency: “May require EU residency; confirm target region / VPC needs.”
- Note: Keep this non-assumptive (avoid claiming they’re “switching providers” or “running on X GPU”).

E) Next best action (CTA)
Required:
- “Recommended owner: {AE/SDR name if available, else routing rule output}”
- “Action: {single verb}” (e.g., “Enroll in sequence”, “Book 15-min triage”, “Hand off to CSM”, “Route to SE for sizing”) 
Optional:
- “Suppression check: {None | Existing opp | Enterprise account | Cool-down active}” (if suppressed, don’t post; if we post anyway for visibility, clearly mark as “FYI - suppressed from task creation”).

F) Links (required)
- HubSpot company record link
- “Playbook: {trigger-specific section}” (Confluence link)
Optional:
- Console intent detail (internal) link
- Dashboard detail (internal) link

Channel variants
- #sales: Default. Keep “Next best action” oriented toward outreach + meeting booking.
- #customer-success: Only for expansion / governance candidates. Add one extra line: “CS note: check existing comms + renewal/contract context before outreach.”

Copy conventions
- Use “PLG Signal” prefix consistently.
- Use “Detected” instead of “Fired” / “Triggered” (less alarmist).
- Always show the window (7d/14d/30d). Avoid ambiguous terms like “recently”.
- Prefer p95 for performance metrics where included; do not include raw logs.

Example message (text rendering)
Header: PLG Signal: Repeated 429s (High Intent)
{Company} ({domain}) hit rate limits repeatedly in the last 7d.
• Segment/Geo: Self-serve / NA
• Window: 7d  | Detected: 2025-02-18 10:42 PT
• Key metrics: 429s/day: 38  | Concurrency p95: 115  | Spend 30d: $4.8k (+22% WoW)
Why it matters: Throttling is blocking growth; Dedicated/quotas tuning can unblock quickly.
Next best action: Owner: {SDR} → Enroll “Rate-limit unblock” sequence + offer 15-min sizing call.
Links: HubSpot | Playbook | (optional) Console usage view

Field contract for Eng (min payload needed)
Required payload fields:
- company_name, company_domain, hubspot_company_id, signal_type, signal_window, detected_at, geo/region, recommended_owner, next_best_action_key
- metrics: up to 3 preformatted “label: value” strings (avoid nested metric JSON in Slack writer)
Optional payload fields:
- suppression_reason, cool_down_remaining, internal_links (console/dashboard)

Open questions
- Do we want an explicit “Confidence” label separate from Score? Recommendation: no for v1; keep to one scalar/band.
- Should we add “Last contacted” timestamp? Recommendation: only if available in HubSpot without adding latency; otherwise link out.

Acceptance criteria
- Final Block Kit layout provided (sections + field labels) and fits within target length.
- Required field list agreed with Eng (ENG-2844) and Biz Systems (HubSpot link format).
- Copy conventions documented and aligned with Sales enablement playbook.

Links
- PRD (Confluence): /product-docs/requirements/plg-to-sales-signal-routing-prd
- Technical design: /product-docs/design-specs/signal-scoring-and-routing-design
- Sales follow-up playbook: /sales-enablement/positioning-and-messaging/plg-signal-followup-playbook

Updates / comments
2025-02-10 (Grace O’Connor): Please keep “Why it matters” to 1 sentence; remove jargon like ‘KV cache’/‘batching’ from Slack. Add explicit “Enroll in sequence” wording.
2025-02-11 (Stephanie Nguyen): Needs clear owner + next step so #sales doesn’t become passive FYI. Also requested geo displayed for handoff clarity.
2025-02-12 (David Kim): HubSpot links should be company record only (avoid contact links). If suppressed due to existing opp, don’t post to #sales.
2025-02-18 (Marissa Cole): Final template posted to ENG-2844. Confirmed PII constraints with security review thread; no user identifiers included.
